description: A flat pad whose resistance drops as you press it: open (megaohms) untouched, about 1 kΩ pressed firmly.
how_to_use: Two legs, no polarity. Like a photoresistor, use it in a voltage divider: one leg to 5V, the other to an analog pin and through a 10 kΩ resistor to GND. analogRead() goes up the harder you press.

plain.what: A thin pad that senses how hard you press it.
plain.how: One leg to 5V, the other leg to an analog pin and through a 10 kΩ resistor to GND. Press it and the number the Arduino reads goes up.
